cards.name: 最热榜 · 结果数据通道
cards.description_zh: 每轮最终榜单结果；当前榜与历史归档各自完整消费。
cards.description_en: Final heat rounds for independent current and archive consumers.
cards.algorithm_zh: 复用Few通道与消息注册机制，发送完整冻结轮次：全体合格候选最终分和排名、前50标记及原始指标；不改变原评分和前50筛选。每轮是完整消息或经清单/校验和确认的完整组，空成功也发rows=[]；失败发unavailable，不用空数组冒充。两个独立消费者组各收全部消息。Topic/Headers/物理分块由Few按现有注册约定绑定，未指定新Topic名字。
cards.algorithm_en: Use the existing registry and transport. Publish a complete frozen scored cohort with top-50 membership, including valid empty success; unavailable is not empty. Independent consumer groups each receive every round. Physical topic and chunking remain Few bindings.
cards.trigger_zh: 每收齐一轮行情并完成计算，可靠发布一次；同snapshot_id重试只允许相同内容。

cards.name: 最热榜 · 更新当前榜单
cards.description_zh: 业务消费组原子更新#1009，保留现有下游。
cards.description_en: Business group atomically updates the existing current board.
cards.algorithm_zh: 独立业务消费组读取完整成功轮次，选in_top50=true且rank为1至50的行，按rank原子替换#1009，不逐行留下半榜。空成功清空；失败保留失败状态、旧榜不冒充当前。按source_as_of和轮次顺序防止迟到重试覆盖新榜，同ID异内容拒绝；写成功才提交本组offset。15分钟过期规则保持。
cards.algorithm_en: Consume complete successful rounds in an independent group. Atomically replace the existing board with top-50 rows, including empty success; failed rounds do not become empty. Reject conflicts and stale overwrites; commit offsets after durable writes. Existing 15-minute expiry applies.
cards.trigger_zh: 收到完整结果消息后；不是独立定时器。

cards.name: 统一归档 · 最热榜结果
cards.description_zh: 统一归档writer的最热结果路由，不另起重复存储服务。
cards.description_en: Heat-result route in the shared archive writer, not another service.
cards.algorithm_zh: 归档消费组独立于业务组，复用现有统一归档writer的注册路由，逐轮持久保存不可变envelope和全部rows。以snapshot_id幂等；同ID异内容隔离报错，写成功才提交本组offset。保存原calculated_at/source_as_of，不以归档时间改写。归档失败重试不阻塞业务组；通道保留须覆盖最大归档延迟和约定重放期，不按资产压缩掉历史。物理分区/保留期由Few明确绑定并验证，不能声称已运行。 归档writer同时维护可追溯的首次观测/确认进榜元数据或索引；裁剪历史前保留已知首次及其证据引用。查询只读，不在网站请求时写历史。
cards.algorithm_en: An independent archival group routes each immutable envelope and full cohort through the existing shared writer. Deduplicate identical snapshot IDs, reject conflicting content, and commit only after durable writes. Preserve original timestamps; retain transport history through archival lag and agreed replay horizon. Few must bind retention and storage. The archive writer maintains durable first-observation/entry metadata and evidence references before pruning. Website queries remain read-only.
cards.trigger_zh: 结果消息到达；独立消费进度，沿用统一writer。

cards.name: leaderboard_hottest_history
cards.description_zh: 每轮最热结果的逻辑历史数据集；不是最新榜缓存。
cards.description_en: Logical immutable history of heat-result rounds.
cards.algorithm_zh: 逻辑主键snapshot_id，每行完整envelope，rows_json按asset_id唯一；可物理拆为批次表与(snapshot_id,asset_id)明细，但须原子确认整轮完整。全候选记录支持离榜后仍有分数；候选无效/未覆盖时是缺失，不补0。保留原始指标、归一化统计、算法/覆盖版本和原时间；Delta/Parquet等复用已有归档能力，物理表绑定和保留期由Few确认。
cards.algorithm_en: Key by snapshot_id with unique asset rows. A header/detail physical split must retain atomic round completeness. Full-cohort rows preserve scores outside the top 50. Missing candidates remain missing, not zero. Preserve metrics, statistics, versions and timestamps. Physical archive binding and retention are Few responsibilities.
cards.trigger_zh: 归档writer持久写入成功后可读。

cards.name: 最热榜 · 查询历史与进榜时间
cards.description_zh: 供网站按币、时间范围读取热度曲线与进榜依据。
cards.description_en: Website-facing heat history and membership query contract.
cards.algorithm_zh: 按asset_id、[from_at,to_at)、resolution和cursor查询归档或可重建索引。返回points_json、membership_json、归档水位与实际覆盖；接口地址由Few提供，不把Studio图API当业务API。round保留每轮；day按Asia/Shanghai取当日最后有效观测，保留实际采样时间和缺口/失败标记。首次观测在榜不等于历史首次进榜：起始已在榜标initial_unknown；只有前一完整可比轮明确榜外→本轮榜内才标confirmed_entry。退出重进保留first_observed_top50_at，另记本次段起点；跨缺口/算法/覆盖变化连续性未知。首次信息要从查询范围之前的历史计算，不能把窗口首条当首次。归档裁剪后只可说保留范围首次，已知首次元数据须持久保存而非随裁剪丢失。分数与排名分开，市场均线未定，不自行加线。
cards.algorithm_en: Query by asset and bounded UTC interval with round/day resolution and stable pagination. Return points, membership evidence, archive watermark and completeness. Shanghai daily points preserve actual sample times and gaps. Initial membership is unknown, not a confirmed first entry; confirm only comparable complete outside-to-inside transitions. Preserve first observation on reentry and mark continuity unknown across gaps/context changes. Compute membership using pre-range history and preserve known metadata across retention pruning. No unapproved market baseline.
cards.trigger_zh: 网站请求时只读；不重新计算或回写过去分数。

cohort_policy: Export the already scored qualified cohort before display truncation; do not change scoring or top-50 membership.
limitations_zh: 仅Studio契约与虚构案例；没有创建Few Topic、消费者、归档表或业务API。原始行情已归档不等于最终榜单已归档。实际消息注册、存储位置、归档水位、保留期、查询性能及端到端运行由Few实现并核验。市场参考线口径未定。
limitations_en: Studio contract and synthetic cases only. No Few topic, consumer, archive table or business API is created. Raw market archives do not prove final-board history. Few must bind and verify registry, storage, watermark, retention, query performance and end-to-end delivery. Market baseline remains undefined.

query_contract.binding_owner: Few Understand agent; provide actual URL after implementation

membership.first_entry_at: UTC|null; only confirmed outside-to-inside transition, never substitute first observation

response.archive_watermark: last contiguous durably archived source cutoff, UTC|null
response.gaps: explicit missing/unavailable intervals, even in daily resolution

rules: Sort (calculated_at,snapshot_id) ascending; bind pagination to filters and a fixed read watermark.
Do not silently join different coverage or algorithm epochs; split/annotate series.
Data predating available history is unknown; absent archive is not not_observed.
Day view retains the actual observation timestamp and explicit within-day gaps; an absent day is not zero.
Current-segment start requires continuous comparable valid rounds; a post-gap in-board observation is not a confirmed reentry.
The archive writer maintains durable first-observation/entry metadata or a rebuildable index backed by retained evidence. Query is read-only. Preserve known firsts before pruning source history.

first_entry_at only confirms the boundary of the first observed membership. If that initial boundary is unknown, keep it null; do not substitute a later confirmed reentry. Later entries belong to the current segment.

message_contract.key: snapshot_id; partition/order strategy bound in Few
message_contract.publication: Atomic complete envelope or manifest-validated complete chunk set; reliable retries from frozen result, no recomputation on replay
message_contract.ordering: Immutable comparable source cutoff + deterministic round order; quarantine conflicting same-cutoff rounds, never replace newer current with older
message_contract.failure: status=unavailable, explicit reason/coverage; cannot infer exits or empty market
message_contract.nested_rows: all qualified scored candidates before top-50 truncation; identical scoring and display selection
message_contract.validation: On success, sample_count equals rows length; asset IDs unique; ranks contiguous and consistent with unchanged full-precision score ordering; rank is rank_all only for 1..50, else null. Required finite metrics/IDs match the frozen round. Reject before both projections on mismatch.
